name: What We Do in the Shadows
description: A documentary-style look into the daily (or rather, nightly) lives of a group of vampires in Staten Island who have “lived” together for hundreds and hundreds of years.

videos.title: After the Shadows Ep. 1 - Kristen Schaal
videos.overview: For the very first episode of After the Shadows, Harvey Guillen welcomes Kristen Schaal! The two celebrate the return of the show and Kristen’s character, The Guide.

videos.title: After the Shadows Ep. 2 - Kayvan Novak and Aida Turturro
videos.overview: Season 3 episode 3 had a LOT going on - a roller coaster of emotions, heartbreak, a rivalry kickball game, and web design. Harvey Guillen welcomes Kayvan Novak and ﻿Aida Turturro to ﻿﻿﻿reminisce about filming the episode and more!

videos.title: After the Shadows Ep. 3 - Shayne Fox
videos.overview: Half-mermaid, half-monkey. Anything is possible in the world of What We Do in the Shadows. In this special episode of After The Shadows, Harvey Guillen takes us behind the scenes and into the brilliant mind of Production Designer, Shayne Fox!

videos.title: After the Shadows Ep. 4 - Anthony Antranik & Marissa Jaret Winokur
videos.overview: Harvey Guillen welcomes your favorite Staten Island next door neighbors for some fun.

videos.title: After the Shadows Ep.5 - Doug Jones
videos.overview: Just when you thought he was gone, we brought him back AGAIN for After the Shadows. Tune in for this very special episode featuring your favorite burnt, crispy vampire.

videos.title: After the Shadows Ep.6 - Prosthetic Makeup Designer
videos.overview: On this episode, you don't just go behind the scenes, you go behind the make-up and into the talented mind of Paul Jones, What We Do in the Shadows' Prosthetic Makeup Designer!

videos.title: After the Shadows Ep. 7 - Cree Summer
videos.overview: She puts the U in cult. On this episode, Harvey is joined by the very talented, very hilarious, very persuasive Cree Summer.

videos.title: After the Shadows Ep. 8: Costumer Designer Laura Montgomery
videos.overview: Harvey Guillen interviews the powerhouse behind all the wardrobe, costume designer Laura Montgomery.

videos.title: After the Shadows | Season 3 Finale With Paul Simms
videos.overview: Relationships, realizations, and really heavy moments, oh my! Showrunner, Executive Producer & Writer Paul Simms and Harvey Guillén are diving into it all.

videos.overview: Alternate Endings to the Series Finale
